analogy.rationale: Antiseptics are non-selective membrane-disrupting biocides with no annotated human target, so they should elicit little coherent transcriptional program in these cell lines; other anti-infective classes share a similar lack of specific human target engagement and are expected to produce weak or nonspecific responses.
